capabilities: convert the active note to Hexo-compatible Markdown via a command
extract Hexo front-matter according to plugin settings
rewrite internal title links, file links and image embeds to Hexo syntax
convert embedded Excalidraw images to svg
upload local images to SM.MS or provide copy buttons for local hosting
extras: Conversion depends on Hexo renderer type and requires hexo-path properties for file link rewriting; README ends with an empty Screenshot section.
problem: Hexo does not understand Obsidian-specific Markdown such as wiki links, embed syntax and Excalidraw embeds, so posts need manual rework before publishing.

relations.evidence: helps users to manage their Hexo posts, including converting notes to Hexo-compatible Markdown format
all local images in the post will be uploaded to SM.MS automatically
Convert embedded Excalidraw images (e.g. ![[test.excalidraw]]) to svg

summary: Converts Obsidian notes to Hexo-compatible Markdown, rewriting front-matter, internal links, embeds and images, with optional SM.MS image upload.
